svg.title: What c1 is made of
svg.desc: A person or agent reaches the control plane's API server. The control plane VM holds the API server, etcd, the scheduler, the controller-manager and a kubelet. The worker VM has a kubelet that starts pods in the media, logging and monitoring namespaces, all using the worker's data disk.
svg.text: Two VMs on the Proxmox host. The control plane runs the cluster, the worker runs the apps in pods, grouped by namespace.
